1.t: When the sun (with its spacious light) is folded up;

2.t: When the stars fall, losing their lustre;

3.t: When the mountains vanish (like a mirage);

4.t: When the she-camels, ten months with young, are left untended;

5.t: When the wild beasts are herded together (in the human habitations);

6.t: When the oceans boil over with a swell;

7.t: When the souls are sorted out, (being joined, like with like);

8.t: When the female (infant), buried alive, is questioned -

9.t: For what crime she was killed;

10.t: When the scrolls are laid open;

11.t: When the world on High is unveiled;

12.t: When the Blazing Fire is kindled to fierce heat;

13.t: And when the Garden is brought near;-

14.t: (Then) shall each soul know what it has put forward.

15.t: So verily I call to witness the planets - that recede,

17.t: And the Night as it dissipates;

18.t: And the Dawn as it breathes away the darkness;-

19.t: Verily this is the word of a most honourable Messenger,

20.t: Endued with Power, with rank before the Lord of the Throne,

21.t: With authority there, (and) faithful to his trust.

22.t: And (O people!) your companion is not one possessed;

23.t: And without doubt he saw him in the clear horizon.

24.t: Neither doth he withhold grudgingly a knowledge of the Unseen.

25.t: Nor is it the word of an evil spirit accursed.

27.t: Verily this is no less than a Message to (all) the Worlds:

28.t: (With profit) to whoever among you wills to go straight:

29.t: But ye shall not will except as Allah wills,- the Cherisher of the Worlds.
